newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: San Miguel shares slip on beer price cut.
newsitem.headline: San Miguel shares slip on beer price cut.

text.p: San Miguel Corp A and B shares dipped in early Monday trade on news it was cutting beer prices, brokers said.
"They are lowering prices and for the short-term it will be bad because while they may maintain market share, it would be at the cost of their margins," said Joey Roxas, president at Eagle Equities.
"It's on the price cut news and based on market talk it may mean an 18 to 20 percent cut in earnings per share," said one foreign broker.
San Miguel said on Sunday it was reducing beer prices effective June 30 to bolster volumes.
San Miguel A share was 50 centavos lower at 44.50 pesos while its B share fell two pesos to 70.50 in early trade.
San Miguel A and B shares were among the top ten most actively traded stocks in early trade.
"There would have been a bigger fall if the Hong Kong stock market was open. As it is, we are trading on light volume," said Bing Trinidad, sales manager at DBS Securities Phils Inc.
"With the price reduction, San Miguel would maintain market share in the long-term but right now its one hope is its overseas expansion," said Roxas.
